subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat streamed replies and continue-recent targeting

question: After real macOS interaction proof is attached, should the macOS owner accept this new Quick Chat streaming and session-targeting workflow for the product?
rationale: The change adds a visible workflow rather than repairing an established contract, and the protected label requires a human owner to judge the desktop UX and lifecycle tradeoffs.

options.title: Review after live proof
options.body: Require a redacted recording or screenshots of selecting a recent session, sending, and receiving a streamed reply before deciding on the current implementation.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Accept only the streamed-reply portion or only recent-session targeting if the combined Quick Chat flow proves too broad for this release.

recommendation.title: Review after live proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted recording or screenshots of selecting a recent session, sending, and receiving a streamed reply before deciding on the current implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature series and assignment connect steipete most directly to the macOS Quick Chat design and follow-up evidence.
